Detaining a PhD student on her way back to Princeton from presenting scientific work at a conference is not how we get the best and brightest scientists in the world to want to come to the US.  I hope this is resolved quickly!  More details:


https://
dailyprincetonian.com/article/2026/1
1/princeton-news-broadfocus-princeton-phd-neuroscience-student-detained-by-immigration-customs-and-enforcement-ice
…
posts.quoted: Our colleague Eva Yi Xie, a Princeton neuroscience PhD student, was detained by ICE at Reagan National Airport on her way home from SfN, where she’d just presented her poster. She’s being held in Chantilly, VA. Please help us bring her home.
